products_page.title: Seven products, [[one operation]]
products_page.text: Each product covers one area. Together they share customers, stock, orders, and payments.

fullvendor.card: Core platform for commercial management and distribution.
fullvendor.lead: The center of your commercial operation: orders, prices, stock, and customers in one place.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor replaces the spreadsheets and disconnected systems of a distributor. Orders go out from here, inventory is checked, the customer base is managed, and the day's numbers are visible. The rest of the ecosystem connects to this base.

benefits.title: One master data set
benefits.text: Customers, products, and prices are shared with sales, warehouse, and finance.

benefits.title: A clear daily operation
benefits.text: Orders, purchasing, and stock no longer live in separate files.

benefits.title: Reports you can use
benefits.text: Sales, margin, and pending work are visible without building a sheet by hand.

benefits.title: Ready to grow
benefits.text: Add logistics, field sales, or ERP when the operation needs them.

fullvendor.audience: Commercial and distribution teams that currently run the business across several systems.

erp.lead: Administration and finance, aligned with what is actually sold and delivered.
erp.about: FullVendor ERP covers accounting, electronic invoicing, payroll, fixed assets, and multi-company. It takes the commercial operation and turns it into entries, documents, and statements the finance team can use.

benefits.title: Connected accounting
benefits.text: What happens in sales and purchasing feeds the books.

benefits.title: Electronic documents
benefits.text: Issue and control invoicing from the same ecosystem.

benefits.title: Several companies
benefits.text: Multi-company for groups that operate more than one legal entity.

benefits.title: Payroll and assets
benefits.text: Payroll and fixed assets next to the rest of the operation.

erp.audience: Administrative and finance teams that want the numbers to match the real operation.

logistics.card: Control and tracking of your logistics operation.
logistics.lead: From the order to the delivery: routes, drivers, and real-time tracking.
logistics.about: FullVendor Logistics organizes distribution. You build routes, assign drivers, and see where each delivery is. Dispatch stops depending on phone calls to know whether the order left.

benefits.title: The day's routes
benefits.text: Deliveries ordered by zone, time window, and capacity.

benefits.title: A driver assigned
benefits.text: Each route has an owner and a clear sequence.

benefits.title: Tracking
benefits.text: You know what is delivered, on the way, or stopped.

benefits.title: Fewer kilometers
benefits.text: Route optimization cuts time and delivery cost.

logistics.audience: Distribution operations with their own fleet or third-party carriers.

supplier.lead: Your suppliers quote, receive orders, and replenish stock without loose email threads.
supplier.about: Vendor Supplier opens a portal so purchasing and suppliers work on the same orders. Quotations, purchase orders, and receiving stay tied to FullVendor inventory.

benefits.title: Orders in one channel
benefits.text: The supplier sees what to deliver, without an email chain.

benefits.title: Comparable quotes
benefits.text: You request prices and choose with the history in view.

benefits.title: Supplier master
benefits.text: Terms, contacts, and pending items in one record.

benefits.title: It hits inventory
benefits.text: What you buy updates stock when it is received.

supplier.audience: Purchasing teams that replenish from several suppliers and need traceability.

salesman.card: Mobile app for the sales team.
salesman.lead: The field team takes orders on the street, with or without a signal.
salesman.about: FullVendor Sales Man puts the salesperson's portfolio, catalog, and order taking on the phone. If there is no internet, work continues and syncs when the signal returns. The order arrives ready to pick and deliver.

benefits.title: The portfolio in a pocket
benefits.text: The seller sees customers, terms, and open items.

benefits.title: The order on the visit
benefits.text: Take the order with current prices and stock.

benefits.title: An up-to-date catalog
benefits.text: Products, pack sizes, and prices without an old PDF.

benefits.title: Truly offline
benefits.text: Work without coverage and sync later.

salesman.audience: Supervisors and field sellers in distribution and consumer goods.

warehouse.lead: Receiving, picking, and dispatch with the phone and the barcode.
warehouse.about: FullVendor Warehouse guides the warehouse through receiving, picking, packing, and dispatch. Barcode scanning cuts errors, and inventory is no longer counted only at month end.

benefits.title: Receive against the order
benefits.text: What comes in is checked against the purchase.

benefits.title: Directed picking
benefits.text: The picker follows the order and confirms each item.

benefits.title: Barcodes
benefits.text: Fewer mistakes of product, lot, or quantity.

benefits.title: Stock you can trust
benefits.text: Every movement updates the platform inventory.

warehouse.audience: Warehouse leads and pickers who still prepare orders from printed lists.

finance.lead: Receivables, payments, and customer status, from the phone.
finance.about: FullVendor Finance shows collections on mobile: what each customer owes, what the company is about to pay, and how payments are coming in. It is for collecting on the visit and for seeing cash without opening a desktop.

benefits.title: Collect on the visit
benefits.text: The seller knows if the customer is current before selling again.

benefits.title: Receivable and payable
benefits.text: Both sides of cash in the same app.

benefits.title: Payments and matching
benefits.text: Record payments and see what still needs to be matched.

benefits.title: Reports in hand
benefits.text: Collection and cash indicators without waiting for a close.

finance.audience: Managers, collectors, and sellers who need the customer's situation at that moment.

resources.title: Clear ideas to [[organize the operation]]
resources.intro: Short guides for distribution managers deciding which system to keep.

unify.title: How to unify distribution in one system
unify.summary: What to bring together first when sales, warehouse, and collections live in different files.
points: Start with customers, products, and prices: that is the master everyone uses.
Connect the order to stock before adding more apps.
Measure one simple number: orders fulfilled without rebuilding the spreadsheet.

offline.title: A sales force that works offline
offline.summary: What to require from an order app so the seller does not stop because of the signal.
points: The catalog and the portfolio have to live on the phone, not only in the cloud.
The order is saved on the device and uploads when the network returns.
When it syncs, the order is already in the warehouse.

warehouse.title: A warehouse with barcodes, without paper
warehouse.summary: How to move from a printed list to picking confirmed on the phone.
points: Receive against the purchase order, not against memory.
Confirm each item while picking. The error stops in the aisle.
Dispatch updates the stock the seller sees.

finance.title: Collections aligned with the sale
finance.summary: Why the seller should see the customer's debt before taking another order.
points: The visit is the best moment to collect, if the debt is visible.
Sales and finance have to look at the same customer.
A daily overdue report is worth more than a late close.

modules.q: Do I have to buy every product?
modules.a: No. You can start with FullVendor and add apps or the ERP when the operation needs them.

offline.q: Do the apps work without internet?
offline.a: Sales Man and Warehouse keep working without a signal and sync when it returns.

multi.q: Does it work if I have more than one company?
multi.a: Yes. The ERP includes multi-company, and the ecosystem can share master data across them.

legal.privacy_intro: This policy explains what we do with the data you leave in the forms on this site.

privacy.title: What we collect
privacy.text: If you request a demo or write to us, we store your name, company, email, phone if you provide it, country, team size, product of interest, and message. We also record the date, the page language, and the IP address, to limit abusive submissions.

privacy.title: What we use it for
privacy.text: We use that data only to reply, schedule a demo, and prepare a commercial proposal. We do not sell it or pass it to a third-party list.

privacy.title: Where it is stored and for how long
privacy.text: Requests are stored on this site's server. We keep them for as long as we need to respond and follow up, and we delete them when you ask or when they are no longer needed.

privacy.title: Your rights
privacy.text: You can ask for access, correction, or deletion through the contact form, saying so in the message. If the company publishes an email on this site, you can also write there.

legal.terms_intro: These terms apply to the use of this FullVendor presentation site.

terms.title: Commercial information
terms.text: The copy, the sample figures on the dashboard, and the descriptions present the platform. They can change as the product changes and they are not a closed offer.

terms.title: The demo is not a contract
terms.text: Sending the form does not create an obligation to buy and does not reserve a price. Any agreement is made separately, in writing, with its scope and conditions.

terms.title: Site content
terms.text: The FullVendor brand, the product names, and the content of these pages belong to their owners. They may not be copied to present another product.

terms.title: Acceptable use
terms.text: Do not use the forms to send false information, spam, or illegal content. We may ignore requests that are not a real commercial conversation.
